verses.pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder
verses.yusufAli: When the Sky is cleft asunder
verses.rodwell: WHEN the Heaven shall CLEAVE asunder
verses.sale: When the heaven shall be cloven in sunder

verses.t: And when the stars fall, scattering
verses.rodwell: And when the stars shall disperse
verses.sale: and when the stars shall be scattered

verses.t: And when the seas are erupted
verses.pickthall: When the seas are poured forth
verses.yusufAli: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth
verses.rodwell: And when the seas shall be commingled
verses.sale: and when the seas shall be suffered to join their waters

verses.t: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered
verses.yusufAli: And when the Graves are turned upside down
verses.rodwell: And when the graves shall be turned upside down
verses.sale: and when the graves shall be turned upside down

verses.t: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back
verses.pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind
verses.yusufAli: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back
verses.rodwell: Each soul shall recognise its earliest and its latest actions
verses.sale: Every soul shall know what it hath committed, and what it hath omitted

verses.t: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous
verses.pickthall: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful
verses.yusufAli: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent
verses.rodwell: O man! what hath misled thee against thy generous Lord
verses.sale: O man, what hath seduced thee against thy gracious Lord

verses.t: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you
verses.pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee
verses.yusufAli: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias
verses.rodwell: Who hath created thee and moulded thee and shaped thee aright
verses.sale: who hath created thee, and put thee together

verses.t: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you
verses.pickthall: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee
verses.yusufAli: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together
verses.rodwell: In the form which pleased Him hath He fashioned thee
verses.sale: and rightly disposed thee? In what form He pleased hath He fashioned thee

verses.t: No! But you deny the Recompense
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment
verses.yusufAli: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment
verses.rodwell: Even so; but ye treat the Judgment as a lie
verses.sale: Assuredly. But ye deny the last judgment as a falsehood

verses.t: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers
verses.pickthall: Lo! there are above you guardians
verses.yusufAli: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you
verses.rodwell: Yet truly there are guardians over you
verses.sale: Verily there are appointed over you guardian angels

verses.yusufAli: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds)
verses.sale: honourable in the sight of God, writing down your actions

verses.yusufAli: They know (and understand) all that ye do
verses.sale: who know that which ye do

verses.t: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight
verses.yusufAli: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss
verses.rodwell: Surely amid delights shall the righteous dwell
verses.sale: The just shall surely be in a place of delight

verses.t: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire
verses.pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell
verses.yusufAli: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire
verses.rodwell: But verily the impure in Hell-fire
verses.sale: But the wicked shall surely be in hell

verses.t: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment
verses.yusufAli: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment
verses.rodwell: They shall be burned at it on the day of doom
verses.sale: they shall be cast therein to be burned, on the day of judgment

verses.t: And never therefrom will they be absent
verses.pickthall: And will not be absent thence
verses.yusufAli: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom
verses.rodwell: And they shall not be able to hide themselves from it
verses.sale: and they shall not be absent therefrom for ever

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is
verses.rodwell: Who shall teach thee what the day of doom is
verses.sale: What shall cause thee to understand what the day of judgment is

verses.t: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is
verses.yusufAli: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is
verses.rodwell: Once more. Who shall teach thee what the day of doom is
verses.sale: Again, what shall cause thee to understand what the day of judgment is

verses.t: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah
verses.pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's
verses.yusufAli: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah
verses.rodwell: It is a day when one soul shall be powerless for another soul: all sovereignty on that day shall be with God
verses.sale: It is a day whereon one soul shall not be able to obtain any thing in behalf of another soul: And the command, on that day, shall be God's
